Description: Earth work excavation for two rain water harvesting tanks
Plain cement concrete below RWH tank bases
Reinforced cement concrete M25 in two tank rafts walls and covers
TMT reinforcement steel for both RCC tanks
Formwork to RCC tank rafts walls and covers
Waterproofing treatment to internal tank surfaces
Back filling around both completed tanks
Borewell drilling to 30 m depth for recharge wells
Slotted pipe pea gravel and borewell completion
UPVC plumbing connections and rainwater inlet pipe
Testing and commissioning of rainwater harvesting system
